title: Seven design calls left open by the 18 Oct audit (note 857)
body:
The 18 Oct audit of the game design document against the last week found calls only you can make. Reply with the number and your answer; any you skip stay as the default.

1. Cinder Hounds' fires: on 9 Oct you said a hound left aboard should relight its car every 90 seconds, be driven off by attack, lunge-bite, and leave by a door. It still relights every 20 s and none of the rest is built. Build it, or has the game moved on? Default: not built.
3. Should a find in a slot slow you like one in your hands does? Today it doesn't. Default: no.
4. The halt's 'dedicated response': a main-line halt has the director's ordinary rules, no lull. Still wanted? Default: left.
5. GDD §8 still says dawn reopens the railway and passenger trains return, dropped when the Wakers came in. Rewrite around the Wakers, or keep the railway as the fiction? Default: rewrite.
6. Solo: your 9 Oct line was 'impossible without friends, smaller reward'. Solo has since got kinder (a coin-flip struggle, something at stops, a child that calls a crew of one). Does the 9 Oct line still stand? Default: the current kinder solo.
7. The inbox's standing orders are empty. Name any (names players never roles; guns' endless shot; no cold). Default: none.
10. Delete the Creature Tweaker's switchman row, and start GDD v1.7? Default: yes to both.
